scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix functions && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-genesis --only firestore "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-genesis --only auth,firestore "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
